notes.subject: שבותנו
notes.rationale: 'our restoration/our fortunes' vs 'our captivity'; imperative שובה makes YHWH himself the one who turns back.

notes.subject: bajisiraw
notes.rationale: אפיקים are dry streambeds that fill suddenly with winter rain in the Negev; 'streams' captures the flash-flood picture.

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: Direct imperative addressed to Yawe — the psalm's turn from report to petition.

translation: Segin, Yawe, ⟨את⟩ an ka lasugini, i n'a fɔ bajisiraw minnu bɛ Negev (worodugu) la.
